configurations.name: web (mock feed)
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR=$HOME/.nvm; . $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh; cd ~/promo/web && FEED_MOCK=1 npx next dev -p 3000

configurations.name: web (production build)
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR=$HOME/.nvm; . $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh; cd ~/promo/web && npx next build && npx next start -p 3000

configurations.name: web (real sheet)
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR=$HOME/.nvm; . $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh; cd ~/promo/web && npx next dev -p 3000
